Manual: CN or list number (PoC). Automatic: policy-driven choice

action_type TRANSFER · cn · sans (CN removed) · profile_id
POST /ui-api/v1/automation with x-api-key. Confirmation prompt when
HTTP status and response JSON → console, pipeline log or runbook

interactive mode loops: automate another → re-discover
Signs the CSR per the TLM
Java · TLM Plugin SDK · runs on the TLM sensor
Data plane only: vault URL + Azure AD client-secret credential, no subscription or ARM role
Secret typed into TLM or resolved at run time through a PAM connector (BeyondTrust, CyberArk, Delinea)
Each certificate becomes its own endpoint <certName>.<vault>:443 so every object is inventoried and renewed independently
Proxy-aware Netty HTTP client; subject normalised for Azure (e-mail moved to SAN, CN-only fallback)
Private key generated and held inside the vault; only the CSR
and the signed chain cross the wire. Consumers (App Gateway,
Front Door, App Service, AKS) pick up the new version.
create on this vault, via access policy
or the RBAC role “Key Vault Certificates
No secrets permission and no Resource
Self-signed or third-party certificate sits in the vault. The plugin discovers it
into the TLM inventory and flags it TRANSFER-eligible.
The script (or any trigger above) submits the automation. TLM runs the plugin: new
version created in the vault, CSR signed by DigiCert, chain merged back.
The object is DigiCert-issued and TLM-managed. Auto-renew in the profile renews it
ahead of expiry through the same plugin, with no manual steps.
DigiCert Trust Lifecycle Manager · Azure Key Vault extensibility plugin and TRANSFER automation script · October 2026
